transcript: Mareez mard, 28 saal. 5 saal se tez bukhar hai. Sar dard hai. Kamzori bhi hai. Kaan dard nahi baad. Thand lagna bilkul din hai. Ulti nahi hai. Dast bhi nahi hai. Typhoid ka test paanch ml rozana, ek goli 7 din. Vardal do goli din mein, 3 baar. jab bukhar ho, 3 din. baad dobara aayein.

medications.name: Typhoid
medications.frequency: 3 times daily when fever is present for 3 days

note.follow_up: return after 3 days if fever persists
